recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key group portrait of seven Black models in an industrial, textured environment. The aesthetic is dark and moody, characterized by metallic textures, leather garments, and a cool-toned, desaturated color palette. The composition is multi-layered, with subjects positioned at varying heights to create a dense, triangular visual structure.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between matte dark skin and reflective metallic/leather textures
Vertical hierarchy from a reclining foreground figure to standing background figures
Tension between the cold industrial setting and the intense, direct gazes of the subjects
Rhythmic repetition of dark, monochromatic tones across diverse fabric textures
coreInvariants: Textured, distressed concrete or metallic background
Direct, confrontational eye contact from all subjects
High-contrast lighting emphasizing bone structure and fabric sheen

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central seated male figure acts as the fulcrum, surrounded by six female figures positioned in a tiered arrangement from the floor to standing height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The reclining figure in the immediate foreground, whose dark skin and black corset create a strong base for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the foreground reclining figure, moves upward to the central seated male, and then fans out to the standing figures on the left and right perimeters.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is tightly packed with figures, creating a sense of intimacy and collective power.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and obsidian blacks (garments and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool greys and metallic silvers (background texture and highlights)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm amber glow from a single industrial bulkhead light
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely low saturation with a focus on value contrast; highlights are reserved for skin sheen and metallic surfaces.
paletteRestrictions: No warm skin tones; skin is graded toward cool, deep ebony

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group of seven Black models in a dark, industrial room with textured grey walls. One model lies in the foreground, one sits centrally, and others stand or lean on industrial props. All wear black leather, denim, or metallic streetwear. Lighting is low-key with a single industrial wall lamp providing a small warm glow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a minimalist, wide-tracked sans-serif in silver foil or white, positioned in the upper third or lower margin to avoid obscuring faces.

verificationChecks: Ensure all models maintain direct eye contact
Check that skin tones are deep and cool-toned
Verify the presence of metallic and leather texture highlights

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the industrial wall light
Specific fabric textures (more leather vs. more denim)
mustRedesign: Any bright or warm color palettes

mustAchieve: Strong sense of group unity and presence

postGenerationChecks: Does the image feel like a cohesive fashion campaign?
Is the lighting dramatic enough to define muscle and fabric edges?
Are the textures of the wall and clothing clearly visible?
Is the central triangular composition maintained?
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Noir Group Portrait: [Subject Count] models + [Monochromatic Dark Palette] + [Industrial Textures] + [Low-Key Tiered Lighting] + [Confrontational Gaze].
